description:
Always allow or always block an email, domain, MX or TLD in this account's validations.
When to use: When the user explicitly wants a validation override for an address or domain.
Parameters: rule — allow or block; target — email, domain, mx or tld; value — the address, domain, MX host or TLD.
WRITE: Changes ZeroBounce account data (uploads, deletes, filters, tests, batch validation, warmup settings). Confirm with the user before calling.
name: add_filter
title: Add allow/block filter
